title: Down-Payment Percentage by Resident Standing — Home-Site Lease Repayment Agreements
content:
The down-payment percentage of a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement turns on full calendar months of tenancy since the move-in date and on whether a repayment agreement was signed on the lease in the trailing twenty-four calendar months.

| Full months of tenancy | Repayment agreement signed on the lease in the trailing 24 calendar months | Down-payment percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | none | 20.0 percent |
| at least 24 but fewer than 60 | none | 22.5 percent |
| fewer than 24 | none | the lot class's minimum down-payment percentage |
| any | one or more | the lot class's minimum down-payment percentage |

In the last two rows no different percentage arises under this schedule.

**At the thresholds (no agreement in the window)**

| Tenure | Percentage |
|---|---|
| exactly 60 months | 20.0 percent |
| 59 months | 22.5 percent |
| exactly 24 months | 22.5 percent |
| 23 months | the lot class's minimum down-payment percentage |

**Hypothetical.** A resident with 84 months of tenancy whose last repayment agreement was signed 30 months ago: no agreement in the window, so 20.0 percent. The same resident with an agreement signed 18 months ago: the lot class's minimum down-payment percentage.
